scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs that show
that some violent scuffle
might have occurred here,
but you can't tell what had
happened exactly...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡似乎發生過激烈的打鬥，具體經過卻無從判斷...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find traces of poison
used in a battle. You sense
its potency and decide not
to get too close to it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了戰鬥中留下的毒液痕跡。
毒性似乎很強，你決定不再靠近。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find traces of poison
used in a battle. A feeling
of acute dizziness overcomes
you after examining the scene.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了戰鬥中留下的毒液痕跡。
檢查現場後，一陣強烈的眩暈襲來。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find traces of poison
used in a battle. A feeling
of acute dizziness overcomes
you after examining the scene.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了戰鬥中留下的毒液痕跡。
檢查現場後，一陣強烈的眩暈襲來。^000000

to get too close to it.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你發現了戰鬥中留下的毒液痕跡。
毒性似乎很強，你決定不再靠近。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are traces of a battle
that seem to be leading in
different directions. From the
peculiar smell that permeates
the area, it seems that some
kind of lethal poison was used.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF戰鬥痕跡向不同方向延伸，四周瀰漫著異味，看來有人使用了致命毒藥。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFStill...
The trail of this
battle decidedly
heads southward.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF不過...戰鬥的蹤跡明顯朝南延伸。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find signs of
a heated pursuit
that head south.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現了激烈追逐留下的痕跡，一路通向南方。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs that show
that some violent scuffle
might have occurred here,
but you can't tell what had
happened exactly...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡似乎發生過激烈的打鬥，具體經過卻無從判斷...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that many people
have traveled through
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡似乎曾有許多人經過。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou've found traces
of the pursuit which
continue eastward.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你找到了繼續向東延伸的追逐痕跡。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese traces of
the pursuit lead
towards the east.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF追逐的痕跡通向東方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著像追逐或打鬥的痕跡，卻無法確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that many people
have traveled through
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡似乎曾有許多人經過。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou examine these traces
and notice that one set of
footprints looks almost too
pronounced, as if it had been
made for somebody to find.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF仔細檢視後，你注意到一串腳印格外清晰，彷彿故意留下，等人發現。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt's a very
strange looking
set of footprints.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這串腳印看著十分古怪。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs that show
that some violent scuffle
might have occurred here,
but you can't tell what had
happened exactly...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡似乎發生過激烈的打鬥，具體經過卻無從判斷...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that many people
have traveled through
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡似乎曾有許多人經過。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFFrom these traces,
you see that another
set of footprints has
been added. It looks like
someone else got involved.
These prints are distinctly
clearer and much smaller.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡多出了一串腳印，似乎又有人捲入其中。
腳印明顯更清晰，也小得多。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFFrom these traces,
you see that another
person has gotten involved
in this heated scuffle.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF從痕跡判斷，又有一人加入了這場激烈打鬥。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著像追逐或打鬥的痕跡，卻無法確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that many people
have traveled through
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡似乎曾有許多人經過。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe traces of the battle
now split and head towards
the north and south. However,^000000
^3355FFthere is a puddle of strong poison that you must neutralize before you can investigate this scene.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF戰鬥的痕跡在這裡分岔，向南北兩邊延伸。
不過，^000000^3355FF地上有一灘劇毒液體，得先中和毒性，才能調查。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFFortunately, you can
temporarily nullify the
poison by using one
of your Green Potions.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF幸好，身上的綠色藥水能暫時中和毒液。^000000

scripts.text: Use Green Potion.
scripts.translation: 使用綠色藥水

scripts.text: Don't use it.
scripts.translation: 不使用

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe poison weakens
and some of it evaporates,
revealing a piece of cloth that
was hidden in that puddle.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF毒性減弱，部分毒液蒸發，露出了藏在其中的一塊布。^000000

scripts.text: Don't investigate.
scripts.translation: 不調查

scripts.text: Investigate.
scripts.translation: 調查

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A piece of cloth
is nothing to be
concerned about.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不過一塊布，不必在意。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey... There's
blood on this cloth
and some writing on
it that I can't recognize.
Hopefully, this'll provide
some sort of clue to all this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦...布上有血，還寫著些不認識的字。
會不會是解開這一切的線索？

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou take the piece
of cloth from the puddle
of poison and keep it with you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你從毒液中取出布片，隨身收好。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm...
It'll probably be
faster if I follow this
trail, rather than stop to
investigate this scene.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...與其停下查現場，順著蹤跡追過去，也許更快。

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou can't find
anything else here,
aside from the traces
that split and lead both
northward and southward.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF除了向南北分岔的痕跡，這裡找不到別的了。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著像追逐或打鬥的痕跡，卻無法確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that many people
have traveled through
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡似乎曾有許多人經過。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese footprints
look like they're
heading towards the
north from the south.
But you can't really
be sure just yet.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF腳印似乎由南向北延伸，可暫時還不能確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著像追逐或打鬥的痕跡，卻無法確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that many people
have traveled through
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡似乎曾有許多人經過。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe trail here looks pretty
muddled, since it looks like
they battled here for quite a
while. But the footprints are
definitely heading south.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF這裡痕跡雜亂，看來打了很久。
不過，腳印確實朝南延伸。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著像追逐或打鬥的痕跡，卻無法確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are two
distinct sets of
footprints in this
area, but they don't
hold any significance
right about now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡有兩串分明的腳印，不過暫時看不出意義。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAround here, it
looks like there are
only two sets of footprints.
What happened to the other
set that you found earlier?^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡只剩兩串腳印，先前另一人的腳印去哪兒了？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFFrom the evidence
that you've found here,
it looks like the battle
involves only two people
from this point onward.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF從留下的痕跡判斷，自此往後，似乎只有兩人在交戰。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著像追逐或打鬥的痕跡，卻無法確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFTraces of some
sort of battle are
scattered all over
this particular area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這一帶，到處都是打鬥的痕跡。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou follow the trail
and although traces from
the north and southeast mix
together, it looks like the battle continues towards the east.
But you should check this
spot a little bit more...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你順著蹤跡查探，來自北方和東南方的痕跡交錯，戰鬥似乎繼續向東延伸。
不過，這裡值得再仔細查查...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAfter investigating this
area more thoroughly,
you find another piece of
cloth stained with blood.
You decide to keep it with
you, hoping that it will
provide more clues.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF仔細搜查後，你又找到一塊染血的布片。
你將它收好，希望能發現更多線索。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou don't find anything,
but you still can't shake
the feeling that there is
some important clue that
you have to find here. It won't hurt to keep investigating here.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF雖一無所獲，你卻總覺得，這裡藏著重要線索，不妨再找找。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou better continue
following this trail
which leads westward.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF繼續沿著向西延伸的蹤跡追查吧。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著像追逐或打鬥的痕跡，卻無法確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
showing that a lot
of people were in
this area earlier.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡先前似乎聚集過許多人。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe lead set of footprints,
probably belonging to the one
who was being pursued, look
more erratic, as if exhaustion
and desperation were setting in. These traces lead to the west.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF最前面的腳印，應該屬於被追趕者，步伐越來越凌亂，似乎已疲憊絕望。
腳印一路通向西方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe trail from
this point heads
towards the west.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF蹤跡從這裡繼續向西延伸。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind

you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著像追逐或打鬥的痕跡，卻無法確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
showing that a lot
of people were in
this area earlier.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡先前似乎聚集過許多人。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFFollowing the
trail, you see signs
that blood was spilled
in this area. It looks like
someone was injured
pretty badly around here.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF沿路發現了血跡，看來有人在這裡受了重傷。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFSince someone involved
in this conflict was bleeding,
further traces of this pursuit
might be easier to find now.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF有人受傷流血，接下來的追逐痕跡，或許會更容易找。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著像追逐或打鬥的痕跡，卻無法確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
showing that a lot
of people were in
this area earlier.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡先前似乎聚集過許多人。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese traces lead
northward and it looks
like whoever is doing
the chasing is getting
much closer to his prey.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF蹤跡通向北方，追趕者似乎已逼近了獵物。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe trail of this
pursuit now leads
towards the north.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF追逐的蹤跡從這裡轉向北方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著像追逐或打鬥的痕跡，卻無法確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
showing that a lot
of people were in
this area earlier.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡先前似乎聚集過許多人。^000000

scripts.text: A large group of people seem to have gone by.
scripts.translation: 似乎有一大群人從這裡經過。

scripts.text:
^3355FFJudging from these
traces, it looks like
even more people have
joined the battle which
now seems to be leading
in the southwest direction.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF從痕跡判斷，又有更多人參戰，打鬥似乎一路向西南延伸。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like
the battle heads
towards the southwest
from this particular point.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF戰鬥似乎從這裡繼續向西南延伸。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著像追逐或打鬥的痕跡，卻無法確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
showing that a lot
of people were in
this area earlier.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡先前似乎聚集過許多人。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFIn this area, it looks
like even more people
joined in this battle and
the pursuit clearly heads
towards the south.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡似乎又有更多人參戰，追逐路線明顯通向南方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThe trail of
this battle heads
towards the south.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF戰鬥的痕跡通向南方。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著像追逐或打鬥的痕跡，卻無法確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
showing that a lot
of people were in
this area earlier.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡先前似乎聚集過許多人。^000000

scripts.text: A large group of people seem to have gone by.
scripts.translation: 似乎有一大群人從這裡經過。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis area is clearly
marked with signs
of a violent battle, with
traces of poison strewn
all over the ground.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF這裡留下了激烈戰鬥的痕跡，地上到處是殘餘毒液。^000000

scripts.text: Continue following the traces.
scripts.translation: 繼續追蹤痕跡

scripts.text: Further investigate the area.
scripts.translation: 仔細搜查附近

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou examine the
trail, but can't really
discern the direction
in which the battle
continues...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你檢查蹤跡，卻分辨不出戰鬥往哪個方向延續...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou find a bunch of
traps that use different
kinds of poison. The ones
that have been set off are
mixed with the ones which
haven't been triggered.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF你發現許多使用不同毒藥的陷阱，有的已觸發，有的還未觸發，混雜在一起。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFOne trap in particular
stands out to you more
than the rest. Perhaps
you should pour some
Green Potion on it to
neutralize it first.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一個陷阱格外引人注意，或許該先倒點綠色藥水，中和毒性。^000000

scripts.text: Pour Green Potion.
scripts.translation: 倒上綠色藥水

scripts.text: Don't use Green Potion.
scripts.translation: 不使用綠色藥水

scripts.text:
^3355FFUnfortunately, you
don't have a Green
Potion that you can
use to pour on this trap...^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF可惜，你沒有綠色藥水可倒在陷阱上...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFPouring that
Green Potion didn't
really make anything
happen. Perhaps you
should try something else.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF倒上綠色藥水，卻沒什麼反應，得試試別的辦法。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess...
I'll try investigating
this area a little more?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...再仔細找找看？

scripts.text:
^3355FFBy sheer accident,
you set off one of
the traps in the area.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF一不小心，你觸發了附近的一個陷阱。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou try grinding
a Green Herb and
sprinkling it on the
trap and then place
a Red Gemstone on it.
The gem glows and
slowly melts away...^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF你磨碎綠色藥草，撒在陷阱上，再放上一塊紅色魔力礦石。
礦石發光，慢慢融化了...^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFAlthough you don't
fully understand the
science of using poisons
or antidotes, you managed
to successfully dismantle
the trap. Now you can safely
check what might be inside.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF雖不太懂毒藥與解毒劑的原理，陷阱總算成功拆除了。
現在能放心檢視裡面的東西。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou should try to
dismantle this trap
by using other catalysts
related to the curing or
use of poison. You do have
a Green Herb on you, so you
try sprinkling it on the trap.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也許可以試試與用毒、解毒有關的其他催化劑，來拆除陷阱。
身上正好有綠色藥草，你試著撒了一些上去。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHowever, nothing
happens. It seems that
you need another catalyst
in addition to the Green Herb
that you have in order to
dismantle this trap.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF沒有反應。
看來，除了綠色藥草，還得加上另一種催化劑，才能拆掉陷阱。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou should try to
dismantle this trap
by using other catalysts
related to the curing or use
of poison. You do have a
Red Gemstone, so you grind
it and sprinkle it on the trap.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也許可以試試與用毒、解毒有關的其他催化劑，來拆除陷阱。
身上正好有紅色魔力礦石，你將它磨碎，撒在陷阱上。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFHowever, nothing
happens. It seems that
you need another catalyst to
use with the Red Gemstone
that you have in order to
dismantle this trap.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF沒有反應。
看來，還得有另一種催化劑配合紅色魔力礦石，才能拆掉陷阱。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou should try to
dismantle this trap
by using other catalysts
related to the curing or
use of poison. But what
items should you bring?^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF也許可以試試與用毒、解毒有關的其他催化劑，來拆除陷阱。
可該帶什麼來呢？^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFInside the dismantled
trap, you find another
piece of strange cloth
that's stained with blood.
You take it with you in
hopes that it provides
some kind of evidence.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF拆開的陷阱裡，又有一塊古怪的染血布片。
你將它收好，希望能作為證據。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFYou examine the area
a little further and guess
that the battle might head
towards the south.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF再查了查四周，你推測，戰鬥可能繼續向南延伸。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese look like
traces of some kind
of pursuit or battle, but
you can't really tell for sure.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF看著像追逐或打鬥的痕跡，卻無法確定。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are signs
that a large group
of people have been in
this area for some reason.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF似乎曾有一大群人，不知為何聚集在這裡。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThese traces lead
to the edge of the cliff.
marking the end of the trail.
Apparently, the one who was
being chased met his fate here.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF蹤跡一直通到崖邊，就此中斷。
看來，被追趕的人在這裡遭了不測。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThere are many footprints
leading to the edge of the
cliff and all of them leave
this scene, save for the set
of footprints that distinctly
belong to the person who
was pursued all this time...^3355FF
scripts.translation: ^3355FF許多腳印通向崖邊，而後又都離開了現場，唯有那串分明屬於被追趕者的腳印，沒有回頭...^3355FF

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like you've
learned all that you can
from this investigation. You
better return and report your
findings to Yierhan soon.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF調查所得，大概就這些了。
趕緊回去，向葉爾汗彙報吧。^000000

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis is the end
of the trail. There
aren't any more traces
of the battle left to find.^000000
scripts.translation: ^3355FF蹤跡到此為止，再沒有別的戰鬥痕跡了。^000000
